sources.title: ActionFi Overview - Action Model - Docs
sources.snippet: ActionFi is the bounty layer of Action Model — a marketplace where apps, protocols, and SaaS tools create task-based missions on their products. Users complete those tasks using the Action Model browser extension, and earn rewards for every verified action.
